# atproto interop vectors

`crypto/`, `data-model/`, `syntax/`, `mst/` and `firehose/` are copied
unchanged from
[bluesky-social/atproto-interop-tests](https://github.com/bluesky-social/atproto-interop-tests)
at commit `056e5741bb330757205d6b16db5266fffcae937b`, which dedicates them to
the public domain under CC0 1.0.

The syntax files list one case per line; lines starting with `#` are
comments, and blank lines are not cases.
